name: Columbus Machine Works
about:
Columbus Machine Works was founded in 1997 in Columbus, Ohio, by Mike Stacey, who began as a job-shop machinist commuting by bicycle to serve local customers. The company has grown into a full-service machine shop operating from a facility on Fairwood Avenue.

The shop provides CNC milling and turning, wire EDM, conventional machining, repair and retrofit services, and welding and fabrication. Its equipment roster includes multiple Mazak and Haas CNC lathes, Haas vertical and horizontal machining centers, a Hitachi wire EDM, and a range of manual lathes, mills, grinders, and presses. The facility spans two buildings with bridge cranes, forklifts, and a dedicated inspection room.

The company serves the medical equipment industry and other industrial clients in Central Ohio, producing OEM replacement parts, prototypes, jigs, fixtures, and tooling. It also offers on-site evaluation, reverse engineering, inventory stocking, and 24/7 emergency breakdown service.

Founded on a passion for machinery and traditional craftsmanship, Columbus Machine Works positions itself as a cost-effective alternative to factory-sourced parts, emphasizing competitive pricing, lead times, and a one-stop solution for machining, fabrication, and repair needs.
